The company is targeting a critical challenge in artificial intelligence development: AI chips generate heat exceeding 140 watts per square centimetre. hits.snippet: # Discovered Materials Raises $9 Million Seed Round To Speed Up Chip Material Discovery With AI Discovered Materials has raised $9 million in seed funding at a time when the chip industry is looking for answers beyond just smaller transistors and faster processors. The startup is working on a hard but important problem – finding new materials that can make semiconductor chips more efficient, cooler and easier to scale. The seed round was led by Lightspeed India Partners. Y Combinator, Peak XV Partners and angel investors including Paul Graham, Gokul Rajaram and Thariq Shihipar also participated. As per reports, the funding is about Rs. 85 crore. At the heart of the company’s plan is a simple idea. If AI is creating a huge demand for more computing power, then AI can also help find the materials needed to support that demand. ## The Main Purpose Of The Funding The aim of the funding is not just to grow quickly like a normal software startup.
